messages:
Maya (PM): proposed rollout for conversational-summary feature. goal: defend quality, limit cost impact, fast rollback. thoughts?
Ethan (Eng): prefer phased traffic slices + shadowing. sketch?
Maya (PM): Phase A: internal + shadow (no billing). Phase B: invite-only beta (2% traffic across us/eu). Phase C: staggered regional ramp to 100%. Each phase has canary checks and a kill-switch.
Rina (Infra): for beta pin to labeled pools pool:beta-us / pool:beta-eu and set autoscale ceiling. need tenant whitelist to warm caches.
Sam (SRE): abort triggers: sustained error-rate >0.75% for 10m, p95 latency >1.4x baseline for 5m, quality drop >3% on eval set, or token-per-response +30% for 15m. On trigger: step 1 auto-fallback to compact-quant, step 2 route to hosted-stable, step 3 flag-off.
Ethan (Eng): flag config idea and rollout steps: 0%->0.5%->2%->5%->25%->100%. hold windows: 30m for early steps, 1h later. expose header X-RW-Bypass for debugging (allowlist + audit).
Maya (PM): QA: automated eval every 5k calls plus two product reviewers on rotation for manual checks. any manual regression triggers rollback.
Rina (Infra): will prepare pool tags and pre-warm. request: list of beta tenant IDs and expected QPS.
Sam (SRE): i'll write the runbook snippets, alert rules, and emergency CLI commands. ops on-call must confirm 10m escalation.
Maya (PM): launch checklist: infra pre-warm, flags staged, metrics wired, eval pass, docs & comms ready, legal OK for EU.
Ethan (Eng): scope: I can ship flagging + fallback in 2 sprints. A/B tooling needs extra sprint unless reused.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: add --shadow to create shadow deploy metadata and post metrics to #canary-monitoring.
Maya (PM): action owners: @Ethan flags/fallback, @Rina pools/pre-warm, @Sam runbook/alerts, @Maya comms/manual review. target: shadow next Wed. Closing thread.
